payload.title: Open revision-pinned report artifacts through durable dashboard links
payload.description:
As an account user, I want durable links to an exact living-report artifact revision, so that I can open or share the evidence that supported a decision without persisting expiring storage URLs.

Out of scope:
- New GraphQL models or infrastructure resources.
- New account roles.
- Artifact retention changes.

Feature: Revision-pinned report artifact links

Scenario: Open an exact artifact revision
Given a Report revision manifest contains a logical artifact descriptor
When an authenticated account user opens its canonical dashboard route
Then the dashboard resolves that exact descriptor
And requests a short-lived read ticket only on demand
And previews or downloads the artifact after checksum verification

Scenario: Show newer evidence without changing the linked evidence
Given an artifact link targets an older Report revision
And a newer revision exists
When the user opens the link
Then the exact linked revision remains selected
And the dashboard offers a clear newer-revision notice

Scenario: Reject invalid or unauthorized references
Given an artifact identifier is missing, unknown, malformed, or belongs to another account
When the route is opened
Then no artifact content is returned
And the user sees an actionable error

Scenario: Use the configured canonical dashboard origin
Given Account settings contain reporting.dashboardBaseUrl
When a report or export creates a durable artifact link
Then it uses that HTTPS origin and the revision-pinned route
And no signed object-storage URL is persisted

Scenario: Preserve zero-resource architecture
Given stable artifact links are enabled
When the backend diff is inspected
Then no GraphQL schema, function, index, association, storage, or IAM resource is added
